ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blocks occupy the center of both lobes, bordered by solid black margins at the trailing edge and median notch. High-contrast black speckling and streaks are concentrated in the distal white regions and near the notch base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with particularly deep notches on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, slightly upward-curled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ovoid high-contrast dark clusters are visible along the distal edges and tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, vertically-oriented black linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, cutting through the primary white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring and rake marks on the right lobe; visible edge degradation and minor tissue loss at the distal fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'barcode' pattern of dark linear abrasions localized specifically on the white field of the right lobe.
